limits: Only the 69 named original Developer images were personally displayed and reviewed. The remaining 1400 accepted cohort images were not individually viewed here.

Developer visual evidence combines 57 originals from the seven complete cases on the original emulator and 12 originals from the two fresh recovery cases. It is not one final remote manifest from a single Developer device.

The original run failed during screenshot synchronization after its passing seed-history case. Its six partial seed images and passing raw seed report are preserved as diagnostics and are not used for acceptance; its pylon case was not run.
Long Excess Charge calculation text is assessed across the top and bottom viewport pair. One image alone does not contain the whole expanded paragraph.

Chooser overlays obscure some controlled map geometry. Exact talent rank, footprint, current-room identity, no automatic action and explicit action timing come from the pinned passing native case, not from pixels alone.

Crystal-room/chest layouts, acquired-talent metadata and boss/pylon/rat states are synthetic controlled fixtures. They do not establish naturally generated encounters, consumed Metamorphosis scroll behavior or balance acceptance.
The unfinished-history case uses a clean unsealed owned log with floor entries 4 to 9 to 4 and no terminal record. It does not simulate a live crash, damaged tail or every older-history format.

The real seed controls and TextInput are exercised, but physical-keyboard behavior is not established. The delayed-worker control proves replacement of an obsolete queued selection, not completion of an already-running older lookup.
The notice reports matching recorded history and explicitly does not prove who originally created the seed.

Static Liquid Agility icons and pylon screenshots do not independently establish numeric defense, expiry or actor time. Those assertions and markers are separately bound to the actual raw native cases.
No physical phone, audio, install-over, new scoring, save compatibility expansion or overall pair publication/delivery is claimed by this scoped review.
The final owner-package and terminal metadata checks are separate from this visual receipt. No locally rerun SDK signing validation is claimed.
